# CH-wide Prediction Maps
## Libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(cowplot)
library(extrafont)
library(ggsci)
```

## Setup
```{r setup}
source("./_config.r")
DIR_PLOTS <- "08_plotting/plots"

# Report column width (147 mm → inches)
REPORT_WIDTH_IN <- 147 / 25.4

# Number of quantile bins for viridis colouring
n_q <- 10

# NPG palette — first colour used for SE maps
pal       <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
se_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#f5f5f5", pal[1]))(n_q)
```

## Spatial boundaries and lakes
```{r setup-boundaries}
# Switzerland national boundary
country_ch <- st_read(
  file.path(PATH_ASSETS, "swissboundaries3d_2025-04_2056_5728.shp/swissBOUNDARIES3D_1_5_TLM_LANDESGEBIET.shp"),
  quiet = TRUE
) |>
  st_zm() |>
  filter(ICC == "CH") |>
  st_transform(2056)

# Lakes >= 2 km², clipped to Switzerland
lakes <- st_read(
  file.path(PATH_ASSETS, "swissTLMRegio_Product_LV95/Hydrography/swissTLMRegio_Lake.shp"),
  quiet = TRUE
) |>
  st_zm() |>
  st_transform(2056) |>
  filter(as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) >= 2e6) |>
  st_intersection(country_ch)
```

## 100 m — Richness predictions

### Bryophyte richness
```{r plot-moss-100m}
# Load moss richness raster and convert to data frame
r_moss    <- rast(file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "moss_richness/prediction_ch_100m.tif"))

# Determine tile size for plotting
tile_sz_m <- res(r_moss)[1]
# Convert raster to data frame and remove NA values
df_moss   <- as.data.frame(r_moss, xy = TRUE)

# Rename the richness column and remove rows with NA values
names(df_moss)[3] <- "richness"

# Create quantile bins for richness values
df_moss   <- df_moss[complete.cases(df_moss), ]
df_moss$q_bin <- cut(df_moss$richness,
  breaks = quantile(df_moss$richness, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_q + 1)),
  include.lowest = TRUE, labels = seq_len(n_q))

# Create the moss richness map using ggplot2
p_moss <- ggplot() +
  # Plot the country boundary
  geom_sf(data = country_ch, fill = "gray85", color = NA) +

  # Plot the moss richness tiles using viridis color scale for richness deciles
  geom_tile(data = df_moss, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = q_bin),
            width = tile_sz_m, height = tile_sz_m) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", name = "Richness decile", drop = FALSE) +

  # Plot the lakes with a specific fill color and border
  geom_sf(data = lakes, fill = "#b8d4e8", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_sf(crs = 2056, expand = FALSE) +

  # Plot the country boundary again to ensure it is on top of the tiles
  geom_sf(data = country_ch, fill = NA, color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.1) +

  # Set the theme to remove axes, grid lines, and background elements for a clean map appearance
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 7, family = "Sans"),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 7, family = "Sans")
  )
p_moss

# Save moss richness map
ggsave(file.path(DIR_PLOTS, "prediction/prediction_moss_100m_viridis.png"),
       p_moss,
       width = REPORT_WIDTH_IN, height = REPORT_WIDTH_IN * 0.38, dpi = 800)
```

### Vascular plant richness
```{r plot-plant-100m}
# Load vascular plant richness raster and convert to data frame
r_plant    <- rast(file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "plant_richness/prediction_ch_100m.tif"))

# Determine tile size for plotting

# Convert raster to data frame and remove NA values
df_plant   <- as.data.frame(r_plant, xy = TRUE)

# Rename the richness column and remove rows with NA values
names(df_plant)[3] <- "richness"

# Create quantile bins for richness values
df_plant   <- df_plant[complete.cases(df_plant), ]
df_plant$q_bin <- cut(df_plant$richness,
  breaks = quantile(df_plant$richness, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_q + 1)),
  include.lowest = TRUE, labels = seq_len(n_q))

# Create the plant richness map using ggplot2
p_plant <- ggplot() +
  # Plot the country boundary
  geom_sf(data = country_ch, fill = "gray85", color = NA) +

  # Plot the plant richness tiles using viridis color scale for richness deciles
  geom_tile(data = df_plant, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = q_bin),
            width = tile_sz_p, height = tile_sz_p) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", name = "Richness decile", drop = FALSE) +

  # Plot the lakes with a specific fill color and border
  geom_sf(data = lakes, fill = "#b8d4e8", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.1) +
  coord_sf(crs = 2056, expand = FALSE) +

  # Plot the country boundary again to ensure it is on top of the tiles
  geom_sf(data = country_ch, fill = NA, color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.1) +

  # Set the theme to remove axes, grid lines, and background elements for a clean map appearance
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 7, family = "Sans"),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 7, family = "Sans")
  )
p_plant

# Save plant richness map
ggsave(file.path(DIR_PLOTS, "prediction/prediction_plant_100m_viridis_legend.png"),
       p_plant,
       width = REPORT_WIDTH_IN, height = REPORT_WIDTH_IN * 0.38, dpi = 800)
```

### Combined figure
```{r plot-combined-100m}
# Extract shared viridis legend from plant map
shared_legend <- get_legend(
  p_plant +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme(
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 7, family = "Sans"),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 7, family = "Sans")
    )
)

# Maps side by side with reduced inner margins
p_maps <- plot_grid(
  p_moss  + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, -3, 0,  0, "mm")),
  p_plant + theme(plot.margin = margin(0,  0, 0, -3, "mm")),
  ncol = 2
)

# Combine maps and shared legend into a single figure
p_combined_100m <- plot_grid(
  p_maps, shared_legend,
  ncol        = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.08)
)
p_combined_100m

# Save combined figure
ggsave(file.path(DIR_PLOTS, "prediction/prediction_combined_100m_viridis.png"),
       p_combined_100m,
       width = REPORT_WIDTH_IN, height = REPORT_WIDTH_IN * 0.38, dpi = 800)
```

## 100 m — Prediction uncertainty (SE)

### Bryophyte SE
```{r plot-moss-se-100m}
# Load moss SE raster and convert to data frame
r_moss_se    <- rast(file.path(DIR_MDL3_OUT, "moss_richness/prediction_ch_100m_se.tif"))

# Determine tile size for plotting
tile_sz_ms   <- res(r_moss_se)[1]
# Convert raster to data frame and remove NA values
df_moss_se   <- as.data.frame(r_moss_se, xy = TRUE)

# Rename the SE column and remove rows with NA values
names(df_moss_se)[3] <- "se"

# Create quantile bins for SE values
df_moss_se   <- df_moss_se[complete.cases(df_moss_se), ]
df_moss_se$q_bin <- cut(df_moss_se$se,
  breaks = quantile(df_moss_se$se, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = n_q + 1)),
  include.lowest = TRUE, labels = seq_len(n_q))

# Create the moss SE map using ggplot2 with a custom color palette for SE deciles
p_moss_se <- ggplot() +
  # Plot the country boundary
  geom_sf(data = country_ch, fill = "gray85", color = NA) +

  # Plot the moss SE tiles using a custom color palette for SE deciles
  geom_tile(data = df_moss_se, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = q_bin),
            width = tile_sz_ms, height = tile_sz_ms) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = se_colors, name = "SE decile", drop = FALSE) +

  # Plot the lakes with a specific fill color and border
  geom_sf(data = lakes, fill = "#b8d4e8", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.1) +

  # Plot the country boundary again to ensure it is on top of the tiles
  geom_sf(data = country_ch, fill = NA, color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.1) +
  
  # Set the theme to remove axes, grid lines, and background elements for a clean map appearance
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 7, family = "Sans"),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 7, family = "Sans")
  )
p_moss_se

# Save moss SE map
ggsave(file.path(DIR_PLOTS, "prediction/prediction_moss_se_100m_legend.png"),
       p_moss_se,
       width = REPORT_WIDTH_IN, height = REPORT_WIDTH_IN * 0.38, dpi = 800)
```
